description: Connect to Zhangsanfeng (finance, inventory & sales, MES). Ask in natural language for income statements, balance sheets, receivables aging, purchase/sales bills, stock, work orders and reporting progress; draft vouchers and purchase-in bills from plain text and post them after confirmation.

display.description_en: Connect to Zhangsanfeng (finance, inventory & sales, MES). Ask in natural language for income statements, balance sheets, receivables aging, purchase/sales bills, stock, work orders and reporting progress; draft vouchers and purchase-in bills from plain text and post them after confirmation.
display.description_zh: 连接账三丰（财务云 / 进销存 / MES）。用自然语言查利润表、资产负债表、往来账龄、采购销售单据、库存、工单与报工进度；也能一句话生成记账凭证或开采购入库单草稿，确认后入账。
examples_en: Which customers have receivables aged over 90 days
Record a 2000 CNY travel expense paid in cash
Purchase 30 peaches from supplier XX at 20 each into warehouse 1
examples_zh: 看一下 8 月的采购入库单
应收账款账龄超过 90 天的有哪些客户
记一笔管理费用差旅费 2000 元，现金付的
从 XX 供应商采购黄桃 30 个，单价 20，入 1 号仓
display.name: 账三丰
